figurative_meaning_en: A spoken euphemism equivalent to 'mule's', used as a special form of polite insult or abuse
example_sentences_in_bangla: এটা অশ্বতরের কাজ, এমন বোকামি করিস না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's as stubborn as a mule.
That's a mule-headed decision, don't be so foolish.
note: This idiom uses 'অশ্বতর' as an archaic or dialectal variant of 'খচ্চর' to soften direct insults involving animals in Bengali speech.
